o.text: Borrowed from Arabic دَفْتَر (daftar), ultimately from Ancient Greek διφθέρα (diphthéra).
By surface analysis, qayıt- (“to come back”) + -ış.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آزمق (āzmaq), from Proto-Turkic *āŕ-. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰀𐰕 (az /⁠āz-⁠/, “to go astray, to lose one's way”), Turkish azmak.
